en: A black‑and‑white street scene showing a row of late‑19th/early‑20th‑century townhouses with steep tiled roofs and dormer windows, lining a wide tree‑planted avenue with tram or rail tracks and a wooden fence in the foreground. Several pedestrians walk along the street. On the corner building a shop sign advertises a manufactory or textile shop in a Central‑European language written in Latin script.
